# APIClaw

> The API layer for AI agents. One key for everything.

## What is APIClaw?

APIClaw provides unified API access for AI agents. One SDK, one API key, thousands of APIs. Intelligent LLM routing across multiple providers.

**For AI agents:** Discover and call APIs instantly. Use the OpenAI-compatible gateway for LLM requests.
**For API providers:** Get your API in front of AI agents.

## Intelligent Gateway

APIClaw routes LLM requests to the best provider automatically:
- Groq for ultra-fast inference (Llama, Mixtral)
- Mistral for European models
- Together AI for open-source (DeepSeek, Qwen)
- OpenRouter as fallback for 800+ models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.)

OpenAI-compatible endpoint: `api.apiclaw.cloud/v1/chat/completions`

One `sk-claw-` key replaces all provider keys. Configure routing mode (fastest, best_price, highest_quality, balanced) in workspace settings. Override per-request with `X-APIClaw-Route` header.

## Three Access Layers

### 1. Direct Call (19 Providers)
Zero config. APIClaw handles authentication, rate limiting, and billing.

**LLM:**
- OpenRouter (800+ LLMs: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama)
- Groq (ultra-fast inference: Llama, Mixtral, Gemma)
- Mistral (Mistral Small, Large, Codestral)
- Together AI (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama)
- Cohere (RAG, reranking, embeddings)

**AI/ML:**
- Replicate (1000+ ML models: Flux, SDXL, Whisper)
- Stability AI (SD3, SDXL image generation)

**Voice:**
- ElevenLabs (text-to-speech, 29 languages)
- Deepgram (speech-to-text, Nova-3)
- AssemblyAI (audio intelligence, diarization)

**Search:**
- Brave Search (privacy-first web search)
- Serper (Google SERP results)

**Scraping:**
- Firecrawl (web scraping and crawling)

**Communication:**
- Twilio (SMS and voice calls, global)
- 46elks (SMS, Nordic/EU, GDPR)

**Email:**
- Resend (transactional email)

**Dev Tools:**
- E2B (code execution sandbox)
- GitHub (repository and code access)

**Multi-API:**
- APILayer (27 APIs: finance, geo, scraping, news)

### 2. Open APIs (1,600+ APIs)
No auth needed. Call directly through APIClaw. Free.

### 3. Discovery (22,392 APIs)
Full API index. Search, explore, integrate. Free and unlimited.

## MCP Tools

- `discover_apis` - Search 22,392 APIs by capability
- `get_api_details` - Full specs, pricing, auth
- `call_api` - Execute through APIClaw proxy
- `list_connected` - See available Direct Call providers
- `check_balance` - Usage and remaining calls
- `register_owner` - Register email, unlock 50 calls/month

## Quick Start

```bash
curl -fsSL https://apiclaw.cloud/install.sh | bash
```

Or use as OpenAI-compatible gateway:

```bash
curl api.apiclaw.cloud/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-claw-..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}'
```

## Pricing

- Free: 50 calls/month, full dashboard
- Pay-as-you-go: Usage-based, unlimited calls
- Pro: $79/month, 5,000 calls
- Scale: $249/month, 25,000 calls
- Enterprise: Custom
